summary.text: Jeff Stone is a Republican member of the Nevada Senate, representing District 20 in Clark County. He has served in the Senate since 2022 and was Assistant Minority Leader in 2025, after earlier service in the California State Senate and in local government in California.

paragraphs.text: The Nevada Legislature says Stone was born in Los Angeles in 1956, holds a Doctor of Pharmacy from the University of Southern California School of Pharmacy, and lists his occupation as pharmacist and Realtor.
His page lists him as mayor and councilmember of Temecula, California, from 1992 to 2004, and as a Riverside County supervisor for the Third District from 2005 to 2014.

Stone served in the California State Senate from 2014 to 2019, and his page lists a presidential appointment as a regional representative at the U.S. Department of Labor from November 2019 to January 2020.
He was first elected to the Nevada Senate in November 2022, served as Co-Minority Whip in 2023, and is a member of the Senate Health and Wellness Committee.
